summary: Implemented the protocol's diversion rule (rule 3): the tool now reads data/status_board.json and rules out hospitals on ED diversion for every patient and on stroke diversion for stroke alerts, with tests. But C-88231 has no eligible destination, so I wrote nothing to dispatch/destination.json: St Brennan (CH-1) and Corran General (CH-2) are on stroke diversion, Valley Regional (CH-3) is on ED diversion, Northgate (CH-5) is 74 minutes away (over 60), Elm Park (CH-6) 35 (over 30), and Harbor Community isn't a stroke centre. Under rule 4 the crew needs to call Medical Control, which names the destination and is the only one who can override a diversion.
